[Detach] removes it from config only; not one byte on disk changes
  · dsh.bat / kill-<port>.bat / dsh-cli.bat stay in the slot,
    so double-clicking still starts it — even if the manager never installed it (the bats use absolute paths)
  · "Scan and adopt" can rediscover it later and
    re-attach it as-is (same port, no file copying)
  · a running slot must be stopped from its card before it can be detached
  · once everything is detached the install root unlocks, so you can switch to another location and install / adopt new ones
